newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai January sugar export at 433,195 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thai January sugar export at 433,195 tonnes.

text.p: Thailand's sugar exports in January rose to 433,195.30 tonnes from 409,010 tonnes during the same period in 1996 and against 26,116 tonnes in December, shippers said on Monday.
Indonesia was the biggest buyer for the month, importing 145,619.8 tonnes of Thai sugar, mostly white and refined. Japan was next with 103,817.7 tonnes of raw and brown sugar, they said.
South Korea and Malaysia were also major buyers of raw sugar from Thailand.

But while South Korea's purchase dropped to 60,800 tonnes from 90,500 tonnes during the same month in 1996, Malaysia's imports surged to 42,000 tonnes from 15,000 tonnes during the same period last year.
Of the total January sugar exports, 256,202 tonnes were raw, 119,189.60 tonnes white, 57,786 tonnes refined and 17.70 tonnes brown.
